name: Demo Yaml Anclajes

on:
    workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
    test-dev:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
            - name: Checkout
              uses: actions/checkout@v4

            - &common-steps
              name: Mostrar entorno
              run: |
                echo "Hola desde github"
                echo "Este es un paso reutilizable"

    test-prod:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
            - name: Checkout
              uses: actions/checkout@v4

            - *common-steps
